audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Yorick and Levels 4-5 read Skill in both layers, against the packet chart (Skill / Zaahen) and against the mirror, which already set both rows from Yorick's side.
audit.why: The content whys already read 'Level 2 is even' and 'Levels 4-5 favour you' — the tokens contradicted their own text.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side -> Skill and win[3]/phases[3].side -> Zaahen as one atomic group, phases[3].rating raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown was given for Eulogy of the Isles or Dark Procession, and the level-6 spike was written as 'Maiden all-in' with Zaahen's R held as an answer.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the reason the 4-5 window exists at all. Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s. Zaahen's R has no CC; it damages and heals.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, spikes[3].text, late and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the timers and the real R behaviour.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page has Yorick's W and E swapped throughout: it calls the E a 'cage' that traps you and describes W as summoning ghouls, in whys[2], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[0]. It also credits Zaahen's W with 'Ominous Return sustain'.
audit.why: Dark Procession (W) is the destructible movement-blocking wall at 600 range; Mourning Mist (E) is a 700-range thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks — and summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets. That mark, not a cage, is what pulls the swarm onto you. And Zaahen's W is a stab-and-pull with no healing; his healing is on Q's double slash. Last Rites is also an auto reset that digs a grave, so the wind-up is the tell and every grave is a future ghoul.
audit.corrected: All nine mis-slotted fields plus dosFull[0..2].d and dontsFull[0..2].d rewritten around the mark, the destructible wall and the Q reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was only in report[8] boilerplate with no mechanism.
audit.why: Last Rites heals on a 6s cooldown at rank 1 — that is what out-sustains poke.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d names the cooldown and Executioner's.
